column6: West elevation of Riverside Library, a two-story facade in tan brick and glass with a recessed central entrance under a standing-seam metal roof.
column7:
Flat orthographic drawing of the library's west face. The two-story building has a symmetrical
composition: a tan-brick base wraps both ends, and a recessed central bay of floor-to-ceiling glazing
marks the main entrance, sheltered by a slim projecting canopy. A standing-seam metal roof with a
shallow pitch caps the building, and a continuous clerestory band runs above the second-floor windows.
Regularly spaced punched windows line the brick end walls. A masonry water-table course runs along the
base, and dashed lines below the ground line indicate the foundation. A key plan with a directional
arrow sits at the upper left.

column6: Site plan of Riverside Library, its rectangular footprint set between River Road and a rear parking lot, with a plaza entrance facing the street.
column7:
Overhead site plan with the library's footprint centered on the parcel. River Road runs along the
lower (street) edge; a surface parking lot occupies the upper portion of the site, reached by a drive
at the right. A paved plaza with planting beds and bicycle racks fronts the main entrance facing River
Road, and a service entrance sits at the rear near the parking lot. Lawn and tree canopy fill the side
setbacks, and a red dashed line traces the property boundary.
